quotes.text: Map `Needs Review` to `In Review`; map `Needs Revision` and other attached states to `In Progress`. Ignore obsolete Bugzilla Phabricator-request attachments by requesting `attachments.is_obsolete`. On status lookup failure/429, retain the attached card, URL, and reported error, with fallback `Attached`/`In Progress`. [Task 1]
